scores.tell: Lamp is cropped at the bottom and the top finial is close to the edge. It is tall and narrow, so it leaves large empty sunburst on the sides. Real cards usually show the whole object, large and centered.
Chair is well scaled and centered. The ledge slices the lower third, and the legs sit close to the bottom.
Chair fills the card at a good size and is centered. There is a clear ground plane, and the hero reads at once. The foot sits a bit close to the bottom.
Five bottles are clustered and cropped by the tent and table. The bottles are a bit small, and the busy scene competes with them. It reads as a scene rather than a single hero.
Helmet is large and centered, with a strong silhouette. The plinth and ledge take some space below. The pink background is clean.
The birdhouse is surrounded by a very busy scene: tree, park, buildings and lamp. These compete with the hero. The hero is tilted and overlapped by the trunk. Real scene cards stay simpler.
Gloves are big, diagonal and cropped by nothing. The striped background is plain. The hero is read instantly. The composition is slightly crowded with the pair.
The pier is a wide scene. It has many parts: posts, ring, rope, water and sand. The focus is spread out and the hero is not one clear object, so it reads as a landscape.
Clock fills the card, is centered and is instantly read. Margins are tight on the left and right, but it is still a good hero. The shelf at the bottom is a small tell.
Chair is large and centered, with the same framing as the c142 chair. The ledge is a little heavy at the bottom. The hero is still clear.
